paintings.title: A Familiar Journey - The Long Way Back Home
paintings.imageAlt: Two figures walk beside loaded camels against a Naples yellow hue background.
paintings.description: Somewhere in the Empty Quarter, a man crosses the desert alongside his daughter. A simple scene that could have happened yesterday, or generations ago. Although in this painting the landscape may seem endless, the scene itself is familiar.
paintings.notes: Approximate location in the Saudi Empty Quarter near the UAE and Oman.

paintings.title: Old Streets, Familiar Scenes
paintings.imageAlt: A figure carries a child through an ochre passage lit by hanging lamps.
paintings.description: As the sun sets, Al Dahu begins to fill with people. In a city that has changed so much over the years, a place like Al Dahu offers something familiar. The narrow streets, architecture, and the way people gather and move brings a little of old, in the center of new; a scene like a father carrying his kid brings familiarity we long to in the chaos of it all.
paintings.notes: Pin marks the Al Dahu market area.

paintings.title: Coffee Culture, Riyadh at 10:47 PM
paintings.imageAlt: A gathering around a coffee counter, painted in shades of blue.
paintings.description: In Riyadh, coffee shops have become more than just places to grab a drink. Somewhere along the way, the coffee became the least important part of going to one.
